[ASSISTANT_SAID] **Thriller/Mystery**:

3. **The Killing of a Sacred Deer** (2017) - A psychological horror-thriller about a surgeon and a sinister teenage boy.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] **Documentary**:  
1. **The Act of Killing** (2012) - A documentary where former Indonesian death squad leaders reenact their crimes.  
2. **The Staircase** (2004) - A true-crime documentary series about the trial of Michael Peterson.  
3. **The Look of Silence** (2014) - A companion piece to **The Act of Killing**, where an optometrist confronts the men who killed his brother.
